snippet.title: 2112TD Gameplay Trailer (Official)
snippet.description:
Get ready for the ULTIMATE tower defense onslaught.

Build your defenses, deploy airstrikes, manage your tactical drone, and hold the line against overwhelming alien hordes.

🎮 Play 2112TD

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2223590/2112TD_Tower_Defense_Survival/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.refineryproductions_2112td
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/2112td-tower-defense-survival/id1514617649
Amazon: https://www.amazon.co.uk/Refinery-Productions-2112TD-Defence-Survival/dp/B08P7NTVNR

🌐 Community Links

Discord Community: https://discord.gg/nsjbZg5v2Q
IndieDB: https://www.indiedb.com/games/2112td
X / Twitter: https://x.com/RefineryGames
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/refinerygames
Reddit Community: https://www.reddit.com/r/2112TD/
Official Website: https://refinerygames.com/


🧠 About 2112TD

Set 100 years in the future, battle interdimensional flesh spawn across the solar system and defend Earth's colonies from complete annihilation.

Build, deploy, research, and upgrade powerful defenses in this epic sci-fi strategy experience.

Set 100 years in the future, humanity is under attack from inter-dimensional bio-organic invaders known as the Fleshomorph.

Command the United Earth Defence Initiative and defend Earth's colonies across the solar system.

Unlike traditional tower defense games, 2112TD focuses heavily on tactical abilities and micro-management, including:

• Airstrikes
• Charged attacks
• Tactical drone support
• Deployable fortifications
• Strategic tower upgrades

Mistakes won’t go unpunished — learn from every battle and refine your strategy.

📰 Press

"Solid old-school tower defense design where every map makes you stop and think."
— Touch Arcade (App of the Week)

"2112TD blends classic Westwood RTS art style with tower defense and it works incredibly well."
— Pocket Gamer (Game of the Week)

#TowerDefense #StrategyGames #RTS #SciFiGames #2112TD
